game.name: Ncaa Football 10 (USA)
game.desc: Settle who's #1 once and for all with NCAA Football 10. With the eyes of college football upon you, begin your Road to Glory in a fully customizable career mode featuring player progression and authentic college football atmospheres. Become college football's biggest star by developing your skills with bonus points earned for solid performances. Dominate your rivals with Freshman mode, featuring an easy-to-use play-calling system with simplified game controls and playbooks. From controlling a player's overall progression to controlling the pace of a game, make a historic run for the BCS National Championship with NCAA Football 10!
